summary: This study investigates the impact of growth conditions on the phase selectivity and epitaxial quality of TiO2 films grown by plasma-assisted atomic layer deposition (PE-ALD). The research demonstrates that using a pure O2 plasma allows for the growth of high-quality, single-phase rutile TiO2 films at low temperatures, while the phase and crystallinity are influenced by growth temperature and substrate orientation. The study also highlights the importance of substrate orientation and gas chemistry in controlling the phase and strain of the deposited TiO2 films.
